title: Odd and even parity products
statement:
Fix a prime $p$, an integer $a\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$, put $q=p^a$,
$k_0=\Fq$, and let $k=\Fbar$ be the
fixed algebraic closure of $k_0$.
Fix an indeterminate $T$.
Let $X_0/k_0$ be
smooth, proper, geometrically
connected of pure dimension
$d\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$, with $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$. For every prime
$\ell\neq p$, write $\Ql=\mathbf Q_\ell$, and let
$P_{i,\ell}\in\Ql[T]$ for
$0\leq i\leq2d$ be the determinant factors in the
smooth-proper
cohomological family. Define

$$
N_\ell(T)=\prod_{\substack{0\leq i\leq2d\\ i\text{ odd}}}P_{i,\ell}(T),
\qquad
D_\ell(T)=\prod_{\substack{0\leq i\leq2d\\ i\text{ even}}}P_{i,\ell}(T).
$$

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against its source (master blueprint node def-weil-parity-products, order 2899): verbatim, kept. The slopmaster2 blueprint defines the same products under the names O_l, E_l (chapters/14_integrality_final.tex lines 106-113, section 'No cancellation before algebraicity'), with the further claims that they lie in 1+T Q_l[T] and that Z(X_0,T)=O_l/E_l; those are assertions, not part of this definition, and are not added here. Named every notion the statement is built from: kept the three imported dependencies (finite-field datum, X, l and Q_l: def-weil-finite-field-fiber; smooth, proper, geometrically connected, pure dimension d: def-weil-geometric-hypotheses; the determinant factors P_{i,l} in Q_l[T]: def-weil-smooth-proper-cohomological-family, reviewed), and added the two Mathlib leaves the statement also uses, def-weil-l-adic-numbers (Q_l = Padic l) and def-weil-polynomial-ring (Q_l[T] = Polynomial). The remaining primitives, a finite product in a commutative ring over the index sets {0<=i<=2d : i odd} and {0<=i<=2d : i even}, are Mathlib's Finset.prod over Finset.filter Odd/Even of Finset.range (2d+1); following the precedent of def-weil-functional-equation-sign and def-weil-determinant-constants they are recorded in mathlib_searches rather than as leaf nodes. No new node was created. With these, N_l and D_l are one-line definitions over def-weil-smooth-proper-cohomological-family; the node is not a leaf itself only because P_{i,l} is not in Mathlib. Lean: no declaration on either branch (audit none is right); the slopmaster2 Lean writes these products inline as ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (2*d+1) ↦ Odd i.1), P i (WeilConjectures/ZetaFunction/IntegralFactors.lean:76-82, ZetaLinearAlgebra/Recovery.lean:65-67).
